note: Read 2026-10-31. Majority: Código Civil Federal (Cámara de Diputados' consolidated PDF), art. 646 (reformed DOF 28-01-1970): majority begins at eighteen full years; art. 647: an adult disposes freely of person and goods. Each state's civil code sets its own majority too (all eighteen as far as known; not read one by one). Emancipation by marriage isn't held (art. 148, reformed DOF 03-06-2019: marriage needs eighteen full years). Work: Ley Federal del Trabajo (last reform DOF 14-05-2026), art. 22 Bis: work under fifteen is barred; from fifteen to seventeen, someone who hasn't finished compulsory basic education may work only where the labour authority approves study and work as compatible (not held); art. 5 I: any stipulation of work for those under fifteen is void. Performers: art. 175 Bis: activities of children under fifteen in artistic creation, musical performance or artistic interpretation, under the supervision of parents or guardians, are not considered work, provided they follow its rules: a written agreement carrying the parents' express consent, no interference with schooling and rest, and the rest of the article (hours and earnings rules not held). No permit is named, so 'free'. Service: Ley del Servicio Militar (DOF 11-09-1940, last reform DOF 18-05-2022), art. 1: service in arms is compulsory for all Mexicans by birth or naturalisation; art. 4: enlistment in the second half of the year a man turns eighteen, service from 1 January after, military obligations ending 31 December of the year he turns forty; art. 5: one year in the active army at eighteen, then the reserves to thirty and forty. Those who go to the active service are drawn by lot (arts. 10-12, sorteo; not held). The Secretaría de la Defensa Nacional's page (dated 20 October 2026) invites women of eighteen or more to take part voluntarily, so only men are called. Duration: Excélsior (26 November 2025) reports the Secretaría's announcement that from 2026 the service is done in three months, thirteen Saturday sessions (or three months 'encuadrado' in barracks); the law's 'un año' is the year's enrolment, and the form holds the three months the Secretaría now asks. The Secretaría's own announcement wasn't found on gob.mx today; Excélsior is marked secondary for it.

sources.said: se declara obligatorio y de orden público el servicio de las armas para todos los mexicanos por nacimiento o naturalización, ... se llevarán a cabo durante el segundo semestre del año en que cumplan los individuos 18 años de edad, comenzando su servicio militar el 1o. de enero del año siguiente. sources.title: Excélsior, "Servicio Militar se realizará en tres meses a partir del 2026" (26 November 2025)
sources.said: A partir del próximo año, el Servicio Militar Nacional (SMN) se realizará en tres meses, con dos sesiones o escalones al año, para que los jóvenes nacidos en 2007 cumplan con esa obligación en 13 sesiones sabatinas, informó la Secretaría de la Defensa Nacional (Defensa).
